oracle-l5r-9927: Shinobi Assault (The Shadow's Embrace, Limited, Ninja). WIRED and tested (ability shinobi-assault-battle, EmperorRulingR1Cards.cs; EmperorRulingR1Tests.ShinobiAssault, through a Strategy that carries its own printed definition) on the battle-without-a-province model (Mendon's ruling): a battlefield created at no province, the performing unbowed Ninja assigned to attack, the target assigned to defend even if bowed, the battle fought inside the Action Phase with the player of Shinobi Assault as its Attacker and holding the first opportunity (a first-opportunity claim), then Lose 5 Honor, then the Action Phase resumes. NOT PUBLISHED: the scan is not in the repository (only assets/reference/oracle/the-shadow-s-embrace/receipts/oracle-l5r-9927-printing-1-image-1.json; there is no images/ or webp/ folder, and the catalogue art pack holds only hashed art), so the printed text could not be read by eye and tools/content/package_vanilla_wave.build_definition_fields cannot copy the art. The Oracle text used for the wiring is 'Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Ninja Personality and target another player's Personality: Create a battlefield (not at any province). Assign your Personality to attack there. Assign the target to defend there, even if he is bowed. Fight a battle there, in which you have the first opportunity to take a Battle action or pass. Lose 5 Honor.' (cost 4, focus 1, Ninja). To publish: supply the scan (webp working copy plus receipt), read it against that text, add a strategy-wave-63 packager with Abilities ["shinobi-assault-battle"], and register the wave (csproj, PublishedContent, CardCatalog, manifest).
oracle-l5r-8922: Two Fronts (Embers of War, Limited). WIRED and tested (ability two-fronts-mark; the primitive is MatchEngine.MarkTwoFronts / CreateTwoFrontsBattlefields, EmperorRulingR1.cs; EmperorRulingR1Tests.TwoFrontsSecondBattle and TwoFrontsCard): 'During your next normal Attack Phase (this turn), create two battlefields associated with it instead of one' makes the declaration of the player's next NORMAL Attack Phase (an additional one does not count) create a second, additional battlefield associated with the marked province; it destroys the province like the first, and when the first battle destroys the province the second is fought at a battlefield without one (both orders tested). Requires the province's player to have two or more provinces. NOT PUBLISHED: the scan is not in the repository (receipt only: assets/reference/oracle/embers-of-war/receipts/oracle-l5r-8922-printing-1-image-1.json). Oracle text used: 'Limited: Target a province whose player has two or more provinces: During your next normal Attack Phase (this turn), create two battlefields associated with it instead of one.' (cost 0, focus 2). The client's attack-assignment picker can name an additional battlefield (BattlefieldName) but has no province mat to click for it; the assignment goes through the sidebar picker. To publish: supply the scan, read it, add the packager with Abilities ["two-fronts-mark"] and register the wave.
oracle-l5r-8257: The Perfect Moment (Forgotten Legacy, Reaction). WIRED and tested (ability perfect-moment-declare; EmperorRulingR1Tests.PerfectMoment): Retribution's window and additional Attack Phase (shared now as DeclareAdditionalAttackPhase): its player, the Defender of the phase that ended, declares the additional Attack Phase and is its Attacker (Mendon's ruling); during it (RulingR1State.PerfectMoment) he destroys at most one of the previous Attacker's provinces (the second victory destroys none), and his Personalities may not be assigned and will not move (assignment, movement to a battlefield and moving home are all refused through MovementLocked) unless they are Paragons or Battle Maidens; Retribution's one-Personality limit and +1F do not apply to it. NOT PUBLISHED: the scan is not in the repository (receipt only: assets/reference/oracle/forgotten-legacy/receipts/oracle-l5r-8257-printing-1-image-1.json). Oracle text used: 'Reaction: After the end of an Attack Phase in which you were the Defender: Create an additional Attack Phase with the previous phase's Attacker as the Defender. During this Attack Phase, you will not destroy more than one of the Defender's provinces and your Personalities may not assign and will not move unless they are Paragons or Battle Maidens.' (cost 0, focus 4). Reading to confirm against the scan: 'will not move' covers every movement of his Personalities during the phase, not only movement to battlefields; a Personality's return home after a battle is the rules' own and is not a movement. To publish: supply the scan, read it, add the packager with Abilities ["perfect-moment-declare"] and register the wave.
oracle-l5r-10184: Aramasu's Legacy (Seeds of Decay Mantis Stronghold, Limited). STILL UNWIRED; this pass built part of what it needed. Its text creates an additional Attack Phase from a Limited action, so inside the Action Phase, during which 'battle resolution does not destroy defending armies or Provinces and does not bow your Mantis Clan Magistrates or your attachments', and afterwards 'if you won any of its battles (even against no units at resolution), you may target a Personality or Holding, bow it, and negate its straightening until after your next turn begins'. Available now: an additional Attack Phase declared by a reaction window (DeclareAdditionalAttackPhase, whose declarer is its Attacker by Mendon's ruling) and a battle fought inside the Action Phase that returns to it with the action's own tail (AsideBattle / FinishAsideBattle). Still missing: (1) a WHOLE Attack Phase (Declaration, Infantry and Cavalry Maneuvers, every battle) entered from and returning to the Action Phase, i.e. AsideBattle generalised to a phase sequence that restores the Action Phase's priority and windows afterwards (the aside battle handles one battlefield); (2) resolution-time exemptions scoped to that one phase instance (no army destroyed, no province destroyed, no bow for the player's Mantis Clan Magistrates or their attachments), which would sit beside RulingR1State.PerfectMoment's phase-scoped restrictions; (3) 'if you won any of its battles' (a per-phase win record, even with no units) driving a delayed optional bow of a Personality or Holding with a straighten hold (StraightenHolds can express 'until after your next turn begins'). NOT PUBLISHABLE either way: no scan in the repository (receipt only: assets/reference/oracle/seeds-of-decay/receipts/oracle-l5r-10184-printing-1-image-1.json); Aramasu's Legacy is a Pre-Game Stronghold, so it is not covered by Mendon's battles-without-a-province explanation and was not built speculatively.
